title: Clarté Baguette Bracelet
descriptionHtml:
Clear light, cut in straight lines. A tennis bracelet of icy clear baguette cut cubic zirconia set crosswise, side by side like the rungs of a ladder, each stone held at its corners by fine gold claws. The line is about 6mm wide and closes with a slim gold fold over clasp, so it lies flat and catches the light from every side. Wear it alone with a white shirt, or beside a fine round line for evening.

STYLING TIP: Stack it with a fine round tennis bracelet so the two cuts play off each other.

Details

  • Length: Approximately 17cm
  • Stone: Baguette cut clear cubic zirconia, approximately 6mm by 3mm, set crosswise
  • Width: Approximately 6mm
  • Setting: Each stone held at its corners by fine gold claws, edge to edge
  • Closure: Fold over clasp
  • Finish: Polished gold tone

Care

Keep it dry and away from perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.
